scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend build complete (no build step needed)'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run post-build
scripts.copy-native-binaries: mkdir -p "Backend/node_modules/better-sqlite3/lib/binding/node-v108-win32-x64" 2>/dev/null || true && cp "Backend/node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node" "Backend/node_modules/better-sqlite3/lib/binding/node-v108-win32-x64/better_sqlite3.node" && echo 'SQLite binary copied' && mkdir -p "dist/Backend/node_modules/bcrypt/lib/binding/napi-v3" 2>/dev/null || true && cp "Backend/node_modules/bcrypt/lib/binding/napi-v3/bcrypt_lib.node" "dist/Backend/node_modules/bcrypt/lib/binding/napi-v3/bcrypt_lib.node" && echo 'bcrypt binary copied'
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run copy-native-binaries && pkg Backend/server.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output releases/helpdesk-jarvis.exe
scripts.dist:win:versioned: npm run build && npm run copy-native-binaries && node scripts/version-build.js
scripts.install-deps: npm install && cd Backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
